name: Affinity
_note: Stage-2 proof pin. The archive is the prefix baked into wine-assess's wine-app-affinity:dev image (docs/wine-app-image.md), exported with .update-timestamp=disable and temp dirs dropped: 4.1 GB prefix, 1.37 GB zstd. INTERIM URL: served by a python http.server on linbox from /mnt/data/wine-app-archives; the intended home is the public labs-sandbox S3 bucket once publish can upload there (see the design doc's open questions). Re-pin by re-running export-prefix.sh and copying name/size/hash from its JSON line.
